negative_snippets:
Their hotel staff was very rude, especially the reception team. I booked this place for two days, and on the second morning they started asking me for extra money, claiming they do not consider bookings made through MakeMyTrip. The guy at the reception was extremely rude to both me and my partner. They are not welcoming at all. Hotel staff are usually polite and helpful, but these people behaved more like goons—arguing over everything and trying to manipulate us to extract more money.

The food was so bad that I genuinely regret ordering from their restaurant.

If you are looking for a proper hotel experience, go somewhere else. This place is full of goons.

Bad behaviour and worst experience in my life.
The hotel room was okay, but the staff’s attitude was extremely unprofessional. The receptionist behaved very rudely, as if we were staying in a day-use lodge. Every time we stepped out, the guard kept asking for money again and again, showing complete misbehaviour. When we complained at the reception, instead of resolving, she misbehaved even more. Overall, it was a very disappointing and unpleasant stay.
